theme_central: The absolute certainty of the resurrection and the final sorting of mankind into three groups: the Foremost, the People of the Right, the People of the Left.
sources_note: Precisely sourced division (ayahguide.com, Deep Reflection & Architecture): 1-6, 7-12, 13-26, 27-40, 41-56, 57-74, 75-82, 83-96.

branches.title: The Event
branches.resume: When the Event (al-waqi'a) occurs, the earth will be shaken, the mountains crushed to powder.

children.t: The Event, the earth shaken, the mountains crushed to powder

branches.title: Threefold division
branches.resume: Introduction of the three groups: the Foremost, the People of the Right, the People of the Left.

children.t: Introduction of the three groups: the Foremost, the right, the left

branches.title: The Foremost
branches.resume: The elite closest to Allah, description of their bliss in Paradise.

branches.title: The People of the Right
branches.resume: The pious majority, description of their reward in Paradise.

children.t: The People of the Right, reward in Paradise

branches.title: The People of the Left
branches.resume: The deniers, description of their torment in Hell.

children.t: The People of the Left, torment in Hell

branches.title: Four challenges about creation
branches.resume: Agriculture, reproduction, water, fire: four arguments from the visible to the unseen.

children.t: Four challenges: who truly creates the seed, the water, the fire, the harvest?

branches.title: Oath, agony, final sorting
branches.resume: Oath by the positions of the stars, scene of the agony, return to the three groups in reverse order.

children.t: Oath by the positions of the stars, authority of the Qur'an
Scene of the agony, final sorting according to the three groups
